title: Switzerland's NCSC says AI agents led to successful compromises in its first confirmed AI-assisted attacks
summary: Switzerland's National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC) says it has confirmed its first cases of AI-assisted attacks on organisations in Switzerland, according to Cyber Security News. The NCSC says that in every case known to the agency, the use of AI agents led to a successful compromise of the victim's IT systems. The article says the NCSC did not name the victims or give the number of attacks.
plain: Switzerland's cyber agency says AI agents were used in its first confirmed AI-assisted attacks on Swiss organisations, and that in every known case the victim's IT systems were compromised.
exec: Switzerland's NCSC says every AI-agent attack known to it succeeded in compromising the victim's IT systems.
action: The NCSC advises requiring multi-factor authentication or passkeys for webmail, VPNs and other internet-reachable services, and taking systems off the public internet when direct access is unnecessary.

validation.note: Only Cyber Security News, relaying the NCSC advisory, was read; the NCSC's own page could not be found (search and the NCSC news page returned nothing).
